name: AJ Styles & Undertaker
meaning: A wrestler laughs, oblivious, while the Undertaker looms silently right behind him. For someone celebrating while unaware of the consequence about to catch up with them.
when_to_use: left = the oblivious, laughing party or what they are enjoying (left side). right = the threat creeping up behind them (top right, near the Undertaker). The looming threat is the punchline.
